description: Compare 2 to 4 software titles from Fileion side by side: publisher, license, platforms, latest versions, pros, cons and key features, plus the feature rows Fileion editors checked by hand (yes, partly or no, with the date). Gives the Fileion "A vs B" page when the first two have one.

slugs.description: 2 to 4 title slugs, as search_software returns them, e.g. ["google-chrome", "mozilla-firefox"].
